reviews.comment: This course is very difficult but Prof Diaz makes it enjoyable. She hosts office hours to help with SAP and Excel. It is very content heavy but is a doable course
This was the worst class I've taken in my life. The prof is really nice and a great person, but the class was BRUTAL. So many assignments!
Gave me candy.

I believe that ACCT 427 should be 2 classes, I believe it was the hardest most material intensive class in the accounting degree plan. 
Professor Diaz handles it amazingly and is always willing to take time to assist in the understanding of the material. Her focus is for us to do well even thought it is a lot of material she is very upfront.

Prof Diaz was great! This class is a lot of work but she makes it doable and genuinely wants to work with you. Textbook reading, SAP (takes a long time), Excel (useful for real life!!), quizzes (easy), and two tests (not that bad if you study hard). Her lectures are engaging and taught in a way that's easy to understand.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed this class and thought that Diaz was an amazing lecturer. She is very engaging whenever she teaches the material and explains things in a way that is easy to comprehend. Highly recommend taking her for 427- the class structure is very clear and she genuinely wants you to succeed.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Diaz is great! This class is difficult and tedious as it pertains to information systems. However, she was very detailed, helpful, and responsive both in and out of class. You can tell she loves the topic she teaches. Participation will help you, and keeping up with the textbook is important as not everything is in lecture

She is super nice but I hated one main thing about this class which was the technology she used. None of it ever worked, myself and the other students would have to go to her about the issues we were having and she'd have to regrade everything. Other than that I didn't interact with her much seeing as though we just listened to guest speakers.

Professor Diaz is very nice and helpful. The class itself is pretty hard with lots of material, and requires you to understand the topics and not just memorize. Be prepared to spend lots of time outside of class (2-3hr chunks) on SAP and studying for tests. Gives extra credit, and is very accessible outside of class for help. Would recommend her.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Diaz is a wonderful professor who is very kind. ACCT 200 is a 1-hour seminar class that exposes you to opportunities in Accounting. Easy A and very informative if you don't know what you want to major in at Mays.

ACCT200 is a seminar class with mostly guest speakers. I am thankful to have taken the class. Dr. Diaz did a great job organizing/leading it. She was approachable before/after lectures. Getting a good grade was easy is you did the work. I would recommend this class to any freshmen interested in accounting/PPA. Nathan the TA was great too.

Overall a good teacher who understands and cares about what she teaches. She tried to prepare us as much as possible for the exams which have a lot of information and usually what she says in class in on the exam. 1 homework assignment could make the difference between an A and a B though so be sure to give yourself plenty of time to complete them.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Respected--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Diaz was a great professor for the summer course. She will answer any question and is very helpful. Very encouraging. The course load can be overbearing sometimes, but definitely doable. I would recommend taking her for Audit!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Course load is the equivalent of at least 6 credit hours. There are tons of assignments and quizzes, which for the most part are tedious. Have to study at least a week in advance for exams. This class is unnecessarily hard and time consuming. Avoid taking this class with her, especially during your PPA recruiting semester.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Diaz was a great prof for this course. The material is real-life applicable and understandable if you put in the effort. She is always willing to answer questions in and out of class. Attending and participating in class will get you farther than you think. The tests have a crazy amount of content so truly study everything taught. Go to class!!!

Dr. Diaz does not teach an easy course. Therefore the course will be hard. Her exams are challenging but are fair and only cover content that was lectured on.  There are several projects in this course and many writing assignments. Dr. Diaz is very accessible outside of class and is always willing to answer questions.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She's not a bad lecturer and the material is not that hard to understand. However, her tests are ridiculous. They seem easy, but she's a very tough grader. You get one part of the question wrong, she takes off a BUNCH of points. There are lots of assignments, but just follow the directions and you'll be fine. I'd try and avoid taking her.

Professor Diaz means well and seems pretty nice but the tests are ridiculously brutal with half the points coming from writing. Also she gives so many assignments which makes the overall courseload overbearing. The material itself is not hard but the way she structures the class is what kills most students. Worst class experience at TAMU so far.

Content is not terribly difficult but half of the points on exams were for writing which is a nonsensical format for the given material and pointlessly makes exams significantly harder. Assignments are long, tedious, and frequent throughout the semester. Also one of the most mind-numbing lecturers at Mays. Would recommend you avoid this professor.

gets frustrated when we make mistakes, and expects you to be an expert on things she hasn't taught us. After the A/R audit that didn't go well, she literally yelled at us in class for getting things wrong even though the example she showed us was much simpler than what she had us actually do ourselves. Does not prepare you well for tests/projects.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: This class is pretty hard for no reason. The material itself is pretty self-explanatory, but Dr. Diaz just really wants to make it a struggle. She is a good lecturer and really a pretty good teacher, but oh my god the exams! They are basically two exams in one 1hr 15min time frame with essays and MC. The homework is also pretty time consuming
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read
